command:
set -e
apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y -qq curl >/dev/null 2>&1
export PGPASSWORD="$PGPASSWORD_IN"
psql -h "$PGHOST" -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 'conn_ok'"
for pair in "flatstick:$URL_FLATSTICK" "fourvault:$URL_FOURVAULT"; do
  db=${pair%%:*}; url=${pair#*:}
  echo "=== $db ==="
  curl -sSf "$url" -o /tmp/$db.dump
  ls -l /tmp/$db.dump
  psql -h "$PGHOST" -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $db"
  psql -h "$PGHOST" -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE $db"
  psql -h "$PGHOST" -U "$PGUSER" -d $db -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"uuid-ossp\"; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;" || true
  pg_restore --no-owner --no-acl -h "$PGHOST" -U "$PGUSER" -d $db /tmp/$db.dump || echo "pg_restore returned non-zero (checking real state below)"
  n=$(psql -h "$PGHOST" -U "$PGUSER" -d $db -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public'")
  echo "RESULT $db public_tables=$n"
  psql -h "$PGHOST" -U "$PGUSER" -d $db -tAc "SELECT relname||'='||n_live_tup FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY relname" | head -40
done
echo RESTORE_DONE

environment.name: URL_FLATSTICK
environment.value: REDACTED-PRESIGNED-URL-see-README (was a short-lived S3 presigned URL for flatstick.dump, regenerate at restore time)

environment.name: URL_FOURVAULT
environment.value: REDACTED-PRESIGNED-URL-see-README (was a short-lived S3 presigned URL for fourvault.dump, regenerate at restore time)

name: pg
